serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Corelight Open NDR is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-
tenant SaaS cloud computing environment. It is an open, evidence-
based Network Detection and Response platform built on community-
driven open-source technologies like Zeek and Suricata, designed to
provide comprehensive network visibility, detect advanced threats
using multi-layered analytics (AI/ML, behavioral, signatures), and
accelerate incident response by generating enriched, forensic-grade
network telemetry.

Open NDR focuses on providing open core and open data for
flexibility, customization, and seamless integration with existing
security tools like SIEM, EDR, and XDR. It is available to federal
government agencies, as well as government contractors etc.).
